LESSON: POSITION AND DIRECTION

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Geometry
Topic 3.1: Position and Direction

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Position and Direction. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

Work to do Use the picture to fill in the spaces 1. To go to the school, Kamau will move ______. 2. To visit the bank, Kamau will walk straight then turn ___________. 3. To visit the shop, Rose will walk straight and turn __________. 4. To visit Kamau, Rose will walk __________. 5. From the bank to the school one will walk straight then turn _________. 93

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-197.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 197]]

GEOMETRY Position and direction Week 11 Lesson 4 Turning to the Right Picture Borehole BAN K Bank

Hospital Farm Example Using the picture To visit the bank from the hospital, a person moves straight then turns RIGHT Work to do Fill in 1. To visit the bore hole from the hospital, one walks straight then turns ________ 2. From the market to the bank one will walk straight then turn _________ 3. From the farm to Moraa’s home you walk straight then turn __________

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Position and Direction means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Position and Direction.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Position and Direction
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3
4. Revise with the quiz now.
